annotation.bound_parties_text: The standard is stated to be relevant to Tier-1 and Tier-2 supply chain suppliers and service providers to the vehicle and its occupants and/or cargo.
annotation.bound_parties_quote:
Tier-1 and Tier-2 supply chain suppliers
Service providers to both the vehicle and its occupants and/or cargo
annotation.legal_effect_quote: PAS 1885 is the international standard on road vehicles that discusses automotive cyber security across the lifetime.
